whenToUse: A long form where errors may be off screen.
A form validated all at once after pressing submit.
Screen reader users need to hear the number and location of errors at once.
whenNotToUse: A short form with one or two fields (inline errors beside the fields are enough).
You validate in real time while people type.
It's a server error unrelated to the form (use an alert banner).

alternatives.name: Inline Validation
alternatives.reason: Reporting errors one by one right under each field. Using it together with an error summary is the default.

alternatives.name: Alert Banner
alternatives.reason: A page-level problem unrelated to specific fields.

accessibility: When the summary appears, move focus to it and read the number of errors at once with role="alert".
Put the count in the title ("Check 2 fields") so people learn first what to do.
Each item links to its field and moves focus into the input, not just the scroll position.
Connect inline errors to the fields with aria-invalid and aria-describedby, using the same words as the summary.
